  "situation": "On 12 April 1999 a NATO aircraft released two bombs against a railway bridge in eastern Serbia that was considered a military supply route. A civilian passenger train was crossing the bridge at the moment and was struck by both bombs, causing at least ten deaths and fifteen injuries. The bridge was the intended target and the train was not deliberately targeted, according to statements from senior officials. After the first bomb hit, the aircraft's weapon operator launched a second bomb aimed at another point on the bridge while the train was still on it. A technical analysis later suggested the operator may have had slightly more reaction time than initially claimed, but still only a few seconds.
